scripts.build: pnpm --filter @adg/game-core build && pnpm --filter @adg/server build && pnpm --filter @adg/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @adg/game-core build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @adg/server dev" "pnpm --filter @adg/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @adg/game-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @adg/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @adg/web typecheck
